name: Maegi Keiji
source: Bright and energetic, he often acts childlike just as his appearance suggests. However, when it really matters, he becomes a manly and dependable senior. He has a habit of meeting others’ eyes and then deliberately looking away, which makes him well-liked by people of all ages and genders.
translation: Bright and energetic, he often acts childlike just as his appearance suggests. However, when it really matters, he becomes a manly and dependable senior. He has a habit of meeting others’ eyes and then deliberately looking away, which makes him well-liked by people of all ages and genders.
